text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару is utterly flummoxed
by her
loss in the Kinko Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Overcome with shock and tears, she
fears that
both good fortune and the
gods have abandoned
her. She begs me
to free her from this nightmare.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her tears don't stop—not even when I
tell her our
next goal is the Takarazuka
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
